items.question: What customs duty rate applies to goods imported into a UAE free zone?
items.gold: 0 per cent customs duty on goods imported into the free zone.
items.fact: Free zone imports carry 0 per cent customs duty

items.question: Can a UAE free zone company be fully owned by foreign investors?
items.gold: Yes, free zone companies can be fully owned by foreign investors.
items.fact: UAE free zone companies allow full foreign investor ownership
